summary: Accepted lean cleanup direction: remove wrapper-only seams, remove stale compatibility re-exports after import migration, align docs to lean actual structure, and gate deletion with dependency/reference scans plus full checks. Hot-path CodeWiki GC remains deferred until cleanup commit proof exists.

diff_table.current_state: TASK-087 intentionally kept wrapper seams such as src/application/compilers/*.ts and src/application/gateway/profiles/*.ts to satisfy transitional architecture docs.
diff_table.desired_state: Delete wrapper-only source seams unless they contain real orchestration or policy; update imports/docs/tests to target the real owner directly.
diff_table.rationale: Empty modules add abstraction without behavior and make package structure harder to reason about.
alternatives: Keep wrapper seams as stable public/internal import paths but document them as intentional compatibility surfaces.

diff_table.current_state: Compatibility re-exports and legacy aliases remain after moves, including src/adapters/web/control-room.ts and src/application/task-boundary.ts; codewiki_claim remains a public compatibility tool alias.
diff_table.desired_state: Remove compatibility re-exports after repo-internal imports migrate; keep only explicitly supported public compatibility aliases, or remove them in a breaking cleanup if approved.
diff_table.rationale: Compatibility files should not linger as permanent duplicate architecture unless they are truly part of supported package API.
alternatives: Retain public aliases through one release cycle and remove only private/internal wrappers now.

diff_table.current_state: System docs still describe target folders like application/gateways and application/state-engine even when source currently uses application/gateway and application/state modules with wrappers.
diff_table.desired_state: Align docs to actual lean structure: domain owns semantics, application owns concrete use cases/tools/local orchestration, adapters/UI translate surfaces; no folder exists just to satisfy architecture words.
diff_table.rationale: Docs should prevent drift and over-abstraction instead of requiring placeholder folders.
alternatives: Rename folders to match docs instead of simplifying docs/code.

diff_table.current_state: Cleanup lacks an executable safety gate for removing wrappers and hot-state artifacts.
diff_table.desired_state: Before deletion, run dependency/reference scan; after deletion, run typecheck, architecture audit, smoke/features/pack tests, stale-reference audit, and CodeWiki state refresh.
diff_table.rationale: Removal should be surgical and reversible through Git, with evidence that no live imports or hot contracts broke.
alternatives: Do only read-only stale scan now; defer deletions to a later task.

Run dependency/reference scan before deletion and typecheck/architecture/smoke/features/pack/stale-reference checks after deletion.
